_why: dev-shots set=stepaside (CI only, never bundled): one real mod that does the same job as an Origin mod, so the shots show Origin stepping aside ('Replaced by Freecam' on the Freelook card). Freecam = the Modrinth build for MC 1.17.1, loaded into this module's runClient through -PextraMods (fabric.addMods; Loader remaps the intermediary jar at launch). No Fabric API here: the dev game already has the module's own. Pinned by Modrinth VERSION id, SHA-512 checked by fetch_mods.py.
